QuestionText: Arrange these letters to make a word: T – A – C
Explanation: Rearranging T, A, C gives CAT — the furry animal that says meow!

QuestionText: Arrange these letters to make a word: D – O – G
Explanation: Rearranging D, O, G gives DOG — your favourite furry pet that loves to play fetch!

QuestionText: Arrange these letters to make a word: H – E – N
Explanation: Rearranging H, E, N gives HEN — a female chicken that lays eggs on the farm!

QuestionText: Arrange these letters to make a word: P – I – G
Explanation: Rearranging P, I, G gives PIG — a pink farm animal that loves to roll in mud!

QuestionText: Arrange these letters to make a word: N – U – S
Explanation: Rearranging N, U, S gives SUN — the bright yellow star that gives us light and warmth!

QuestionText: Arrange these letters to make a word: C – U – P
Explanation: Rearranging C, U, P gives CUP — the small vessel you use to drink tea or water!

QuestionText: Arrange these letters to make a word: R – A – T
Explanation: Rearranging R, A, T gives RAT — a small animal with a long tail often seen in stories!

QuestionText: Arrange these letters to make a word: T – A – H
Explanation: Rearranging T, A, H gives HAT — something you wear on your head!

QuestionText: Arrange these letters to make a word (Hint: it is used in tennis and cricket): N – E – T
Explanation: Rearranging N, E, T gives NET — the mesh used to catch balls in many sports!

QuestionText: Arrange these letters to make a word (Hint: an animal you keep at home): T – E – P
Explanation: Rearranging T, E, P gives PET — an animal you love and keep at home, like a dog or a cat!

QuestionText: Arrange these letters to make a word (Hint: a part of your body): G – E – L
Explanation: Rearranging G, E, L gives LEG — the part of your body you use to walk and run!

QuestionText: Arrange these letters to make a word (Hint: it shows you the way): P – A – M
Explanation: Rearranging P, A, M gives MAP — a picture that shows you where places are!

QuestionText: Arrange these letters to make a word (Hint: it keeps you cool in summer): N – A – F
Explanation: Rearranging N, A, F gives FAN — the spinning machine that blows cool air in summer!

QuestionText: I am big and grey. I have a very long trunk and large ears. I live in the jungle. What am I?
Explanation: An Elephant is big and grey, has a long trunk, and very large ears. It lives in the jungle!

QuestionText: I have beautiful colourful wings. I fly from flower to flower and drink sweet nectar. What am I?
Explanation: A Butterfly has colourful wings and visits flowers to drink nectar. It starts life as a caterpillar!

QuestionText: I live in water. I have scales all over my body and fins to help me swim. What am I?
Explanation: A Fish lives in water, has scales on its body, and uses its fins to swim around!

QuestionText: I live in trees and love to eat bananas. I have a long tail and swing from branch to branch. What am I?
Explanation: A Monkey loves bananas, lives in trees, and uses its long tail to swing from branch to branch!

QuestionText: I live on a farm. I give you fresh milk every day. I say MOO. What am I?
Explanation: A Cow lives on a farm, gives milk, and says MOO. Your morning milk comes from a cow!

QuestionText: I am round and very bright yellow. I shine in the sky during the day and give warmth to everyone. What am I?
Explanation: The Sun is round and bright yellow, shines during the day, and keeps us warm and alive!

QuestionText: I have four wheels. People sit inside me and I take them from one place to another. What am I?
Explanation: A Car has four wheels and people sit inside it to travel from place to place!

QuestionText: You sit on me. I have four legs and a back to support you. I am found at tables in schools. What am I?
Explanation: A Chair has four legs and a back, and you sit on it when you eat or study!

QuestionText: I am soft and white. I fall from the sky when it is very cold in winter. Children love to play in me. What am I?
Explanation: Snow is soft and white, falls from the sky in cold weather, and children love to make snowballs!

QuestionText: I am a yellow, curved fruit. I am sweet and soft. Monkeys love to eat me. What am I?
Explanation: A Banana is yellow, curved, sweet, and soft. Monkeys absolutely love bananas!

QuestionText: I am round and red. I am sweet and juicy. I grow on a tree. Eating me keeps you healthy. What am I?
Explanation: An Apple is round, red, sweet, and juicy. It grows on a tree and is very healthy!

QuestionText: I have numbers and two moving hands. I hang on the wall. I tell you what time it is. What am I?
Explanation: A Clock has numbers and moving hands that point to the time. We look at it to know the time!

QuestionText: You lie on me at night. I am soft and comfortable. I have a pillow at the top. What am I?
Explanation: A Bed is soft and comfortable to sleep on at night. It usually has a soft pillow for your head!

QuestionText: You carry me on your back. I hold your books, pencils, and lunch box. I am called a _____.
SubTopic: Making a Word from a Hint
Explanation: A Bag is carried on your back to school. It holds all your books, pencils, and lunch box!

QuestionText: I am round and flat. You wear me on your head. I keep the bright sun out of your eyes. I am called a _____.
SubTopic: Making a Word from a Hint
Explanation: A Cap is round and flat, worn on the head to shield your eyes from the sun!

QuestionText: I twinkle and shine in the night sky. There are thousands of me up above. I am called a _____.
SubTopic: Making a Word from a Hint
Explanation: Stars twinkle and shine in the night sky. When you look up at night, you can see thousands of stars!

QuestionText: You use me to draw and colour pictures. I come in many beautiful colours. I am called a _____.
SubTopic: Making a Word from a Hint
Explanation: Crayons come in many colours and are used to colour pictures. Children love to draw with crayons!

QuestionText: I am on your face. You use me every day to smell flowers, food, and things around you. I am called a _____.
SubTopic: Making a Word from a Hint
Explanation: Your Nose is in the middle of your face and is used for smelling. You smell flowers with your nose!

QuestionText: You wear me on your hands when the weather is cold. I keep your fingers warm. I am called _____.
SubTopic: Making a Word from a Hint
Explanation: Gloves are worn on your hands to keep your fingers warm in cold weather!

QuestionText: I am round. You bounce me on the ground and throw me to your friends. I am called a _____.
SubTopic: Making a Word from a Hint
Explanation: A Ball is round and bouncy. You play cricket, football, and many other fun games with a ball!

QuestionText: I am sweet and come in many colours. Children love to eat me at birthday parties. I am called _____.
SubTopic: Making a Word from a Hint
Explanation: Candy is sweet and colourful. Children enjoy eating candy on special occasions like birthdays!

QuestionText: I am a bright yellow fruit. I taste very sour. People squeeze my juice into drinks. I am called a _____.
SubTopic: Making a Word from a Hint
Explanation: A Lemon is bright yellow and very sour. People squeeze lemon juice into drinks to make them refreshing!

QuestionText: I have many pages. You open me to read stories or learn new things. I am called a _____.
SubTopic: Making a Word from a Hint
Explanation: A Book has many pages with words and pictures. You read books to learn and enjoy great stories!

QuestionText: I have two wheels and pedals. You sit on me and push the pedals with your feet to ride. I am called a _____.
SubTopic: Making a Word from a Hint
Explanation: A Bicycle has two wheels and pedals. You ride it by pushing the pedals with your feet!

QuestionText: I am soft and warm. You pull me over yourself at night to stay cosy while you sleep. I am called a _____.
SubTopic: Making a Word from a Hint
Explanation: A Blanket is soft and warm. You cover yourself with it at night to stay cosy and sleep well!

QuestionText: Which of the following words is spelled CORRECTLY?
Explanation: The correct spelling is ELEPHANT — E-L-E-P-H-A-N-T. It has eight letters and a tricky 'ph' in the middle!

QuestionText: Which of the following words is spelled CORRECTLY?
Explanation: The correct spelling is BUTTERFLY — B-U-T-T-E-R-F-L-Y. It has double T and ends in Y!

QuestionText: Which of the following words is spelled CORRECTLY?
Explanation: The correct spelling is HAPPY — H-A-P-P-Y. It has double P and ends with Y!

QuestionText: Which of the following words is spelled CORRECTLY?
Explanation: The correct spelling is FRIEND — F-R-I-E-N-D. Remember the tricky 'ie' in the middle!

QuestionText: Which of the following words is spelled CORRECTLY?
Explanation: The correct spelling is ORANGE — O-R-A-N-G-E. It ends with a silent 'e'!

QuestionText: Which of the following words is spelled CORRECTLY?
Explanation: The correct spelling is FLOWER — F-L-O-W-E-R. A flower grows in the garden and smells beautiful!

QuestionText: Which of the following words is spelled CORRECTLY?
Explanation: The correct spelling is BUTTER — B-U-T-T-E-R. It has double T in the middle!

QuestionText: Which of the following words is spelled CORRECTLY?
Explanation: The correct spelling is YELLOW — Y-E-L-L-O-W. It has double L and ends in OW!

QuestionText: Which of the following words is spelled CORRECTLY?
Explanation: The correct spelling is MONKEY — M-O-N-K-E-Y. It ends in KEY — just like the key to a lock!

QuestionText: Which of the following words is spelled CORRECTLY?
Explanation: The correct spelling is GARDEN — G-A-R-D-E-N. A garden is a beautiful place where flowers and plants grow!

QuestionText: Which of the following words is spelled CORRECTLY?
Explanation: The correct spelling is PENCIL — P-E-N-C-I-L. You use a pencil to write and draw!

QuestionText: Which of the following words is spelled CORRECTLY?
Explanation: The correct spelling is SCHOOL — S-C-H-O-O-L. It has a silent C and double O in the middle!
